title: Water Witness
description: Studio Birthplace's campaign Inequality by the Gallon made with Don't Panic London for Water Witness exposes the hidden water footprint behind everyday supermarket products and the communities affected by it.

content.about:
## *Inequality by The Gallon* exposes **the hidden water footprint** behind everyday supermarket products and the communities affected by it.

The campaign film shows a supermarket aisle flooding as products burst open with water, eventually **revealing the real-world impact of this hidden consumption in a water-scarce community.**

content.heading: Flooded Aisles
content.body:
Most of us walk through a supermarket several times a week, filling our baskets without realizing that every product carries a story far beyond the shelf. In truth, there is a hidden water usage attached to the products we buy, water taken from communities and ecosystems far from our homes.

‍

Water Witness is a non-profit organization focused on addressing the global water crisis by promoting sustainable, equitable water management.

‍

content.heading: Get Involved
content.text: Add your voice and join Water Witness in enforcing stronger sustainable and fair water use for all businesses.

button.label: Act to Demand a Fair Water Footprint

content.quote: “Our work often focuses on making the unseen seen. We are surrounded by products, yet we rarely see their hidden impact. This film makes the invisible water footprint connected to these products visible.”
content.cite: Directors Sil van der Woerd & Jorik Dozy
